name: CampusOne ERP
tagline: Academic ERP for an autonomous engineering college with 6,000 students
summary: CampusOne runs admissions, attendance, CIE marks, SEE results, fees, timetables, library, logins, SMS alerts and NAAC/NBA reports for an autonomous engineering college. Result-day crashes, wrong attendance percentages and overwritten marks return every semester.

tour.headline: The results portal recomputes every SGPA on every page view and has crashed on three result days; precomputing costs 16 hours.

modules.description: Applications, merit lists and seat allotment

modules.name: attendance
modules.description: Class attendance, biometric sync and shortage lists

modules.name: exams
modules.description: CIE marks entry, moderation and eligibility

modules.name: results
modules.description: SEE results portal, SGPA/CGPA and revaluation

modules.name: fees
modules.description: Fee demand, online payment and receipts

modules.description: SMS and email to students and parents

incidents.title: Results portal down on result day
incidents.desc: When SEE results were published at 6 PM, 5,800 students logged in within 10 minutes; the portal returned 504 errors for 47 minutes and the principal's office was flooded with calls.
whys: Students could not view results
Results pages timed out under load
Every page view recomputed SGPA from raw marks
Results are computed on the fly instead of precomputed and cached
incidents.fix: Added two more application servers for the evening.
incidents.lesson: More servers postponed the crash by a few minutes.

incidents.title: Shortage list includes students above 75% attendance
incidents.desc: The attendance shortage list for 5th semester included 63 students who actually had more than 75%; parents were wrongly informed.
whys: Wrong students appeared on the shortage list
Attendance percentage was understated
Holidays from the academic calendar are counted as conducted classes
incidents.fix: Recomputed the list after removing holidays by hand.
incidents.lesson: The calendar is not used by the attendance code.

incidents.title: CIE marks lost after two faculty edited the same sheet
incidents.desc: Internal assessment marks entered by one faculty member for three sections disappeared after a co-teacher saved an older copy of the same marks sheet.
whys: Entered CIE marks were lost
A later save overwrote the earlier one
Marks sheet is saved with last-write-wins and no versioning
incidents.fix: Re-entered marks from the faculty's paper record.
incidents.lesson: Only the paper copy saved us.

incidents.title: Fee paid online but portal still shows dues
incidents.desc: Students who paid through the bank gateway on the last date still saw dues and were blocked from downloading hall tickets.
whys: Paid fees still showed as due
The payment success callback was not processed
Processing failed when the bank retried the same callback
Payment callback handling is not idempotent
incidents.fix: Marked 214 payments as paid from the bank statement.
incidents.lesson: The bank retries callbacks; our code is not ready for it.

incidents.title: Same lab assigned to two batches at the same time
incidents.desc: The new timetable placed two batches in the Networks lab on Tuesday afternoons; one batch sat in a corridor for the first week.
whys: Two batches were scheduled in one lab
Room availability was not checked when generating the timetable
Timetable generator does not validate room and faculty conflicts together
incidents.lesson: Clashes are found by students, not by the generator.

incidents.title: Password reset OTP not delivered to students
incidents.desc: Students could not reset forgotten passwords for a whole afternoon because OTP SMS were not delivered.
whys: Students could not reset passwords
OTP SMS were not delivered
SMS gateway calls are synchronous with no retry
incidents.lesson: One SMS failure means one locked-out student.

incidents.title: Library fine charged for Sundays and holidays
incidents.desc: Students were fined for days the library was closed, including Sundays and the Dasara holidays.
whys: Fines included closed days
Fine calculation counts calendar days
Fine rules do not use the academic calendar
incidents.lesson: Another module ignoring the academic calendar.

incidents.title: Merit list ranked wrongly for students with equal marks
incidents.desc: Students with equal entrance scores were not ordered by the tie-break rules in the admission notification; three seat allotments had to be redone.
whys: Seat allotment order was wrong
Ties were broken in the wrong order
Tie-break rules are hard-coded and out of date
incidents.fix: Re-ran allotment for the affected seats.
incidents.lesson: Admission rules change yearly; code does not.

incidents.title: NAAC criterion report takes three hours to generate
incidents.desc: The criterion 2 report for the NAAC visit timed out repeatedly; staff stayed late exporting data to Excel.
whys: The NAAC report was very slow
The report joins five years of attendance records
Reports run on the live database without summary tables
incidents.lesson: Reports and live attendance entry fight for the same database.

incidents.title: Students able to view other students' marks by editing the URL
incidents.desc: A student found that changing the student number in the marks page URL showed another student's CIE marks.
whys: Other students' marks were visible
The marks page reads the student number from the URL
Authorization check missing on the marks endpoint
incidents.lesson: Every endpoint needs an ownership check.

incidents.title: Two fee receipts generated for one payment
incidents.desc: The bank resent the success callback after a timeout and the ERP issued a second receipt number for the same payment, upsetting the accounts audit.
whys: Two receipts were generated for one payment
The bank retried the success callback
Payment callback handling is not idempotent
incidents.lesson: Same callback problem as the dues mismatch.

incidents.title: Biometric attendance sync duplicates entries
incidents.desc: Biometric punches were imported twice on some days, inflating attendance for 300 students.
whys: Attendance entries were duplicated
The biometric sync re-imports the whole day
The sync has no last-synced marker

incidents.title: Results page timing out during revaluation results
incidents.desc: Revaluation results caused another surge; the results page timed out for 25 minutes.
whys: Students could not view revaluation results
Results pages timed out under load
Results are computed on the fly instead of precomputed and cached
incidents.fix: Published results in batches by branch.

incidents.title: Exam timetable SMS reached students after the exam started
incidents.desc: The make-up exam timetable SMS was delivered two hours late; 40 students missed the first exam.
whys: Students received the exam timetable late
The bulk SMS job stalled on gateway errors
SMS gateway calls are synchronous with no retry
incidents.fix: Conducted a re-exam for the 40 students.
incidents.lesson: Bulk SMS must not block on failures.

incidents.title: Attendance percentage differs between faculty and student views
incidents.desc: Students saw 72% while their faculty report showed 78%; the student view counts holidays as classes.
whys: Attendance percentages did not match
The student view counts holidays as classes
Holidays from the academic calendar are counted as conducted classes
incidents.lesson: Same calendar problem in a second query.

incidents.title: ERP slow during the 9 AM attendance hour
incidents.desc: Attendance entry took over a minute per class between 9:00 and 9:30 when all faculty mark attendance together.
whys: The ERP was slow at 9 AM
All faculty enter attendance at the same time
Attendance save writes one row per student with a separate commit
incidents.lesson: The save is still one commit per student.

incidents.title: Internal marks reverted to old values after moderation
incidents.desc: After the department moderation meeting, marks for two subjects went back to pre-moderation values because an old browser tab saved the sheet.
whys: Moderated CIE marks were lost
A later save overwrote the earlier one
Marks sheet is saved with last-write-wins and no versioning

incidents.title: Faculty double-booked for two sections
incidents.desc: A professor was scheduled for two sections in the same slot after an elective was added mid-semester.
whys: A faculty member was double-booked
Faculty availability was not checked when the timetable changed
Timetable generator does not validate room and faculty conflicts together

incidents.title: SGPA rounding differs from the university rules
incidents.desc: Some SGPAs were 0.01 higher than the university's published method because rounding was applied at each step.
whys: SGPA values differed from university rules
Rounding was applied at each step
Grade computation rules are not centralised
incidents.fix: Recomputed and republished the affected results.

incidents.title: Hall ticket blocked although fee payment succeeded
incidents.desc: Ninety students were blocked from hall tickets the day before exams although the bank confirmed their payments.
whys: Hall tickets were blocked for paid students
The payment success callback was not processed
Payment callback handling is not idempotent

incidents.title: Book return not reflected for two days
incidents.desc: Returned books stayed on student accounts for two days and fines kept increasing.
whys: Returned books still showed as issued
Returns are posted by a nightly batch
The library desk has no real-time return posting

incidents.title: Result portal crashed again for odd-semester results
incidents.desc: The odd-semester results release brought the portal down for 38 minutes again, despite the extra servers.
whys: Students could not view results
Results pages timed out under load
Every page view recomputed SGPA from raw marks
Results are computed on the fly instead of precomputed and cached

incidents.title: Document upload fails for PDFs above 2 MB
incidents.desc: Applicants could not upload scanned certificates larger than 2 MB during admissions.
whys: Certificate uploads failed
The upload limit is 2 MB
The upload limit is configured in two places that disagree

incidents.title: NBA CO-PO attainment report blank for electives
incidents.desc: The NBA attainment report showed empty values for all elective courses.
whys: Attainment values were blank
Elective course mappings are missing
CO-PO mapping is entered only for core courses

debts.title: Precompute results and serve cached result pages
debts.desc: Compute SGPA/CGPA once when results are approved and serve static result pages from cache on result day.
debts.cause: Results are computed on the fly instead of precomputed and cached

debts.title: Shared academic calendar service
debts.desc: One service for working days, holidays and exam days used by every module.

debts.title: Compute attendance from the academic calendar
debts.desc: Exclude holidays and cancelled classes in both faculty and student views.
debts.cause: Holidays from the academic calendar are counted as conducted classes

debts.title: Optimistic locking with a version column for marks sheets
debts.desc: Reject saves from stale copies and show who changed what.
debts.cause: Marks sheet is saved with last-write-wins and no versioning

debts.title: Audit log for marks changes
debts.desc: Record every marks change with user, time, old and new value.

debts.title: Idempotent fee callback and daily bank reconciliation
debts.desc: Handle repeated bank callbacks safely and reconcile against the bank statement every night.
debts.cause: Payment callback handling is not idempotent

debts.title: Constraint-checked timetable generation
debts.desc: Validate room capacity, lab availability and faculty clashes together on every change.
debts.cause: Timetable generator does not validate room and faculty conflicts together

debts.title: Queued SMS sending with retries
debts.desc: Queue OTP and bulk SMS separately and retry failures with backoff.
debts.cause: SMS gateway calls are synchronous with no retry

debts.title: Ownership checks on every marks and results endpoint
debts.desc: Students can read only their own records; add tests for each endpoint.
debts.cause: Authorization check missing on the marks endpoint

debts.title: Summary tables for NAAC and NBA reports
debts.desc: Nightly aggregates so reports never scan raw attendance.
debts.cause: Reports run on the live database without summary tables

debts.title: Centralise grade and SGPA rules
debts.desc: One tested module implementing the university's grading and rounding rules.
debts.cause: Grade computation rules are not centralised

debts.title: Incremental biometric sync with a watermark
debts.desc: Import only punches after the last synced time.
debts.cause: The sync has no last-synced marker

debts.title: Batch attendance saves in one transaction
debts.desc: Save a whole class's attendance in one commit.
debts.cause: Attendance save writes one row per student with a separate commit

debts.title: Library fines from the academic calendar
debts.cause: Fine rules do not use the academic calendar

debts.title: Configurable admission tie-break rules
debts.desc: Read tie-break order from the yearly admission notification settings.
debts.cause: Tie-break rules are hard-coded and out of date
